_comment: B0.2 specialist audit, 2026-08-12. Per-node classification of every occurrence of 'specialist'/'specialists'/'SPECIALIST' in claims.json. SENSES: A = prospective/reserved (a FUTURE outside expert; asserts nobody has done it). B = a pass that RAN and whose output was banked -- the class that reads as external validation. C = collective/generic ('three specialists conflict'). D = filename reference (SPECIALIST_BRIEF*.md as a path). The emitter tallies this file and REFUSES if the total disagrees with a live case-insensitive scan of the register -- which is exactly the check the first run lacked.
_method: re.compile(r'specialists?', re.I) over json.dumps(claim) per claim and the raw file.
